name: Rolling Stone
summary: A shedding trick-taking game where failing to follow suit forces you to pick up the trick.
rules_text: Use a standard 52-card deck trimmed by player count: for 4 players remove 2s-6s (32 cards); for 5 players remove 2s-4s (40 cards); for 6 players remove 2s only (48 cards). Deal 8 cards to each player one at a time clockwise. Player left of dealer leads any card. In clockwise order, each player must follow suit if able. If a player cannot follow suit, they pick up all cards currently in the trick into their hand and then lead any card to start a new trick. If all players follow suit, the highest card of the led suit wins the trick; those cards are discarded to a waste pile and do not return to any hand, and the winner leads the next trick. First player to empty their hand wins.
rating_reason: Shedding trick-taking game, hidden hands, strategic sequential choice
